title: On the skew-curvature power law relationship in a stochastic volatility model with infinite variation L\'evy jumps
abstract: arXiv:2610.23488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The short-term blow up behaviour of the ATM-IV skew is commonly modelled by either a rough volatility process with small Hurst index or an infinite variation L\'evy process in the log-price dynamics. In this paper, we examine which is the effect of mixed dynamics (i.e. rough volatility and infinite variation L\'evy processes) on the ATM-IV skew and curvature.   The results of the paper show that the analysis of the leading terms of the short-time expansion of both ATM-IV skew and curvature allow us to determine, from a mixed dynamics model, which mechanism originates the power-law behaviour on the skew and on the curvature. Apart from showing that the mixed model also originates a power law, it has also key implications in model design and calibration.   Numerical evidences for the rough Heston model with CGMY L\'evy jumps are provided.

translated_title: 关于具有无穷变差Lévy跳跃的随机波动率模型中偏度-曲率幂律关系的研究
translated_abstract: ATM-IV偏度（平值期权隐含波动率偏度）的短期爆炸行为通常通过两种方式建模：具有小Hurst指数的粗糙波动率过程，或对数价格动态中的无穷变差Lévy过程。本文研究了混合动态（即粗糙波动率和无穷变差Lévy过程）对ATM-IV偏度和曲率的影响。研究结果表明，通过对ATM-IV偏度和曲率短期展开的主项进行分析，我们可以从混合动态模型中确定是哪种机制产生了偏度和曲率上的幂律行为。除了证明混合模型同样会产生幂律之外，这一结果在模型设计和校准方面也具有重要意义。文中还提供了具有CGMY Lévy跳跃的粗糙Heston模型的数值证据。
tldr: 本文通过分析粗糙波动率与无穷变差Lévy跳跃混合模型中ATM隐含波动率偏度和曲率短期展开的主项，确定了产生幂律行为的机制，对模型设计和校准具有重要意义。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes the leading terms of the short-time expansion of ATM-IV skew and curvature in a mixed dynamics model combining rough volatility and infinite variation Lévy jumps, identifying which mechanism generates the power-law behavior, with key implications for model design and calibration.
